primary_metric_space: pseudobulk log2FC proxy; not a VCC score
non_inferiority_note: Not set, as in m001-m004 and g002. The decision rule below is a directional comparison with paired intervals, not a non-inferiority claim.
winner_reason: No winner. Architecture was not selected on the external test. Every fold trains on more than one context, so a context descriptor can vary in training and a with/without comparison is at least identifiable in principle; two contexts still confound biology with the experiment each came from. If seed intervals overlap, the result is inconclusive.

candidates_not_acquired.why_smallest: Roadmap R-1: 0.851 GB compressed, 145,473 × 9,624, 4,976 NTC. Smallest complete perturbed object with explicit NTCs.
candidates_not_acquired.role_if_acquired: methodological evaluation bundle: generator × predictor on real perturbed cells. NOT a benchmark of the 300-target panel.
candidates_not_acquired.read_mode: chunked; do not materialise the dense matrix (~5.6 GB)
candidates_not_acquired.license_note: public GEO; confirm before any submission use

candidates_not_acquired.why: Roadmap R-1 alternative: 1.237 GB compressed, 247,914 × 8,749, 11,485 NTC. Same experiment as the local RPE1 pseudobulk.
candidates_not_acquired.role_if_acquired: pairs with local RPE1 pseudobulk: same biological context, real single-cell counts for the six VCC metrics.

acquisition.byte_budget: the smaller of the two candidates is ~0.85 GB compressed; keep ≥10 GiB free (D-005)
acquisition.after_download: chunked subset of perturbed cells + paired NTCs, written as an evaluation bundle with a new --out, never overwriting existing reports

what_this_does_not_show: A better generator is not evidence that the predictor is adequate.
A better generator is not evidence that modularity is useless.
Zero panel overlap: this bundle would not score the 300 VCC targets.

estimated_bundle_pilot.note: 30 × 80 + 400 NTC at 8,749 genes, float32 dense ≈ 98 MB. CSR of integer counts would be smaller. This is a planning figure, not a measurement.

expression_gate.base_note: The only arm below the null in all three folds of CP-0013. The gate reuses its selected alpha and prior_sd on the same split; the run checks that the base it refits scores exactly like the shrunk_transfer row, and stops if not.

presence.reader: No new reader. Benchmark contexts: the ControlProfile already loaded by the runner (extract_control_profile for pseudobulk sources, scripts/55_control_profile.py for nadig_hepg2). Official contexts, when needed: inference.read_basal_profile.
presence.unmeasured_note: A gene the profile does not measure gets weight 1: missing evidence is not evidence of absence (D-009), and the gate does not act without evidence.

weight.note: Continuous: about 0 where the gene is absent, about 1 where it is clearly expressed, exactly 0.5 at the midpoint. At slope 2 the weight is 0.12 one decade below the midpoint and 0.88 one decade above; at slope 4, 0.018 and 0.982. No switch.

grid.grid_note: Fixed without looking at any response or any presence distribution. 1 CPM is roughly where a gene enters a Replogle panel, 5 CPM is the scorer's filter, 100 CPM is a mid-to-high expressed gene. positive_attenuation is G2's second parameter: the positive part of the delta is multiplied by 1 - beta * (1 - w), so beta = 0 leaves it intact and beta = 1 would be G1.

selection.pair_note: The same pair ShrunkTransfer calibrates on: donor = training contexts other than internal_dest_context, destination = internal_dest_context. The destination gate reads the internal destination's controls, the source gate the donors'. The test context is not read during selection.
selection.fallback: If the base amplitude was predetermined (internal pair too small) or fewer than 3 validation targets exist, the gate is the identity and the row says why.

permutation.output_gene_gates: Presence values shuffled among the genes of the fold universe, once, with the seed; the same map at selection and at test. Shuffling inside the scored genes keeps the distribution of weights on those genes identical to the real gate, so C1 differs from the real gate by the gene-context link alone.
permutation.target_gate: Target presence values shuffled among the fold's targets, with the same seed.

source_presence.note: At test the prediction comes from all training contexts combined with equal weight per context (context_equal_weights), so the source presence is the equal-weight mean of their log10 CPM. At selection the source is the donor side of the internal pair. The source gate never reads the query context.

G1.note: Every gene's predicted delta times its weight.

G2.note: Kept separate from G1: the biologically more defensible variant. An absent gene cannot go DOWN but can go UP: the weight applies to the negative part of the delta; the positive part is left intact or attenuated by beta.

G3.note: If the TARGET gene is not expressed in the destination, knocking it down cannot do much: the whole predicted response for that target is multiplied by the target's weight.

expression_gate.controls_note: The brief asks for C1 and C2 on "the best variant". Choosing the best variant needs numbers, so every variant gets both controls instead, and nothing is chosen after the fact.

decision_rule.owner_confirmation_note: Proposed in the brief for this work as "da confermare con il proprietario". Not confirmed before the run. Changing it after the numbers exist would make it a post-hoc rule, and the checkpoint has to say so if that happens.
decision_rule.statistic_note: `diff` is paired_difference on per-target mse_vs_null: the mean over test targets of (arm a - arm b), bootstrap over targets, n_boot and seed as in `evaluation`. It is the "differenza appaiata per bersaglio" of CP-0013. `diff_paired_pooled` is recorded beside it and does not decide anything.
decision_rule.unit_note: Three folds x two development seeds = six splits per comparison. A fold passes a clause only if both seeds do. On this protocol the two seeds share the test targets and differ in the inner validation targets, i.e. in what the gate parameters were selected on.

clauses.text: On the held-out context's targets, V beats ShrunkTransfer on the paired per-target difference in ALL THREE folds, with IC95 excluding zero.
The permuted gate (C1) does not beat V.
The gate built on the source contexts (C2) does measurably worse than the one built on the destination: positive difference, IC95 excluding zero, in every fold.

reading_clauses.text: If this does NOT hold on every split, the report must say that the gain, if any, is not attributable to the gene-context link but to a global compression -- even when the three clauses above promote the variant. The brief states it: "se il permutato va come quello vero, il guadagno non viene dal legame gene-contesto".
If G2 beats G1 on every split, that is biological information (an absent gene cannot go down but can go up), not only a numerical one.

decision_rule.if_not_promoted: Registered as not adopted, and the result is kept.
decision_rule.promoted_means: Candidate for a confirmation run on the reserved seed 4242 (configs/eval_protocol.yaml, D-032). Not adoption, not a submission, not a winner.
decision_rule.identity_selected_note: The grid contains the identity gate (constant weight 1). If the internal selection picks it, the arm IS shrunk_transfer on that split, the paired difference is exactly zero, and the first clause fails there. That is a result and is recorded as such.
decision_rule.do_not_conclude: Nothing about the six VCC metrics, nothing about the 300-target panel (0/300 in HepG2), and nothing about A/B/C. No gate parameter is chosen on a test context.
